ai_summary: GeM is the national public procurement portal connecting government buyers with sellers/MSMEs.
ai_explanation: GeM is an open e-marketplace where government departments buy goods/services and businesses (including MSMEs) sell. It brings transparency, MSE preferences, and faster payments. Sellers register with business and tax details and list catalogues.
